steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
List. Each requirement is stacked with its criterion, owner and classification.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 requirements need an owner or a classification
outcome.notChecked: Whether the system can meet the requirement.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 medium, 1 low).
[medium] req-data.md:12  Data item with no classification.
       Fix: Classify the data.
[medium] req-integrations.md:19  Integration with no owner.
       Fix: Name the owner.
[low] req-availability.md:26  Requirement with no criterion.
       Fix: Write a measurable criterion.
Not checked: Whether the system can meet the requirement.
pros: Flags a requirement with no criterion, a data item with no classification, and an integration with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Whether the system can meet the requirement.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-system-requirements skill on the records for this review.
